column1: # Breakages Sideeye already knows about on Zig releases newer than the one build.zig.zon pins.
# Read by spike/zig-ahead.sh for .github/workflows/zig-ahead.yml (#698, ADR 0111): <os> TAB <key> TAB <text> TAB <issue>.
# <os> is linux, macos or * (both). <key> is a release's MAJOR.MINOR or master. <text> is a fixed
# string of 10+ characters. A failing lane is green only when every compiler diagnostic it prints
# contains the text of one of its rows AND every one of its rows' texts appears in some diagnostic.
# So a row may name only a breakage the lane prints TODAY: Zig stops at build.zig before compiling
# anything else, and a breakage hidden behind an earlier one gets its row when it shows. The change
# that fixes a breakage removes its row — a lane goes red while a row is left for what it no longer
# prints, whether it now builds or still fails on something else.
